responsibility: Declares the public interface for Temporary Expression Replacement used during out-of-SSA. It exports the routine that discovers replaceable SSA expressions as a bitmap over SSA versions and a dump helper for debugging the chosen substitutions.
same_name_distinction: This header is just the narrow public interface for TER, declaring the bitmap-producing analysis entry point and dump helper used during out-of-SSA. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-ter.cc, it contains none of the replacement-safety analysis or dependency/kill tracking logic.
